answers.answer: A relational database the platform provides. The app reads where to connect from DATABASE_HOST, DATABASE_PORT, DATABASE_NAME and DATABASE_USER and signs in with its own identity. We don't bring our own, and there's no password.
Only the four database settings: DATABASE_HOST, DATABASE_PORT, DATABASE_NAME and DATABASE_USER. The certificate bundle is a file in the folder. Nothing else.
The agent desktop calls it over HTTPS. It doesn't need to be private.
No, it answers each request on its own and connects fresh each time. Nothing has to stay running between them.
Yes, that's right. It answers requests and keeps notes in a relational database.
